## 2024-04-27 - O(1) String Splitting Optimization
**Learning:** Found an O(N*M) bottleneck in `AnalyzedContent` where `Array.prototype.some` was iterating over a list of highlight words for every single text fragment generated by `String.prototype.split(regex)`.
**Action:** Replaced the inner loop with an O(1) index check (`index % 2 === 1`), leveraging the behavior of `String.prototype.split` with a capturing regex, where matches are always placed at odd indices. This removes the nested iteration entirely.
